name: BMA_Enabling_Tasks_Overdue_Alert
description: Runs every 2 hours between 07:00 and 17:00 AEST on weekdays. Detects enabling tasks that are past their planned end date without being marked complete. Sends a targeted alert to the responsible superintendent (not a broadcast — only the accountable person is notified). Escalates to mine planner if the task is on the critical path.

Get_Overdue_Tasks.description: Get all tasks that are past their planned end date and not complete

parameters.$filter: Status ne 'Complete' and Status ne 'Cancelled' and PlannedEndDate lt '@{formatDateTime(utcNow(), 'yyyy-MM-dd')}'

Get_Department_Info.description: Look up the department record to get the superintendent's email and Teams channel

Send_Superintendent_Alert.description: Send a targeted Teams message directly to the superintendent — not a broadcast

Condition_Critical_Path_Escalation.description: If critical path AND more than 1 day overdue, also alert the mine planner

Alert_Mine_Planner.description: Escalate to mine planner for critical path overdue tasks
